slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether a signed contract must be kept active for its entire term or whether partial usage is allowed.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether at least two distinct contract lengths must be used; it only asked about a maximum number of contracts.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there any limit on the number of warehouses (i.e., number of parallel contracts) that can be rented, or is it effectively unlimited?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about a limit on the number of contracts, which led to the max-distinct-contracts clarification.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total rental cost over the 4 months, and must the rented area in each month be at least the required area (allowing renting more than needed)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether monthly rented area must match required area or whether extra space is allowed, covering exact satisfaction.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total rental cost over the 4 months...
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirmed the objective is to minimize total rental cost over the 4 months.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to use at least two distinct contract lengths; any combination of contract types is allowed subject only to the at-most-3-contracts limit.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about contract-length diversity, and the user simulator did not volunteer it; the READY_TO_MODEL summary omits any diversification constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 contract-length diversity requirement remained unresolved and was silently omitted.

summary: The agent resolved the core P0 objective and exact-demand slots and clarified several boundary rules, but it missed the P1 contract-length diversity requirement and stopped prematurely with that hidden slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
